name: demo-playwright-rust-for-google-search
summary: A Rust + playwright-rs test-pattern demo for Google Search: real assertions, never executed against the live site.
description: This repo demonstrates playwright-rs syntax and interaction patterns against Google Search using three real assertion-based test functions: a home page title check, a search-and-results-title check, and a click-first-result hostname check. Google's Terms of Service restrict automated querying of Google Search, so this code is never compiled, checked, or run against the live google.com; see README.md and AGENTS.md.
